title: Run credential-free integration acceptance and rollout
description:
Purpose: Integrate, verify, and roll out the application-authenticated local workflow.

Acceptance:
- Python 3.11 and 3.12 CI pass.
- Dashboard typecheck, unit, Storybook build, and browser tests pass.
- Sandbox environment contains no AWS profile or session variables.
- One plexus login supports an accuracy evaluation with a stored dataset.
- A feedback evaluation persists complete root-cause evidence.
- A local optimizer checkpoints and resumes with final artifacts visible in the dashboard.
- An expired access token refreshes without user or AWS intervention.
- Additive backend support deploys before migrated clients.
- Production acceptance uses a controlled evaluation with no local AWS credentials.

Close only after final rollout verification is recorded.

comments.author: ryan.porter
comments.text: Integration kickoff: combine PRs #507, #508, and #509 on isolated branch codex/integrate-artifact-ticket-migrations from current develop. Keep the urgent production Amplify compile repair separate. Retarget the three migration PRs away from develop, preserve their histories, resolve cross-lane conflicts only on the integration branch, then run the task's complete local and sandbox acceptance gates before opening one integration-to-develop PR.

comments.author: ryan.porter
comments.text: Combined branch d3d60ede passed focused migration coverage (144 Python tests), ticket/schema contracts (19 tests), dashboard typecheck plus explicit Amplify backend typecheck, dashboard unit coverage (91 suites / 669 tests), and the dispatch regression net (13 tests). Full Python 3.12 found auth-migration test harness drift plus two pre-existing input-source test failures reproducible on develop a002fcbc. Repaired only test injection/expectations: patch the imported score-chat dependency, treat missing runtime auth as an execution failure rather than a Click parse failure, and inject the fake score through the explicit resolver seam. Focused rerun: 19 passed. No production auth fallback or runtime behavior changed.

comments.author: ryan.porter
comments.text: Combined sandbox acceptance found that persisted procedure state survives credential-free reload, but Tactus checkpoint entries using concrete types such as explicit_checkpoint are omitted because the migration serializer accepts only the literal type checkpoint. Fix must preserve all execution-log checkpoint types and replay metadata, then rerun live checkpoint reload and focused CI before the integration PR.
